name: Protopasta Conductive PLA @base
filament_notes:
Carbon-black conductive PLA (4043D base). FAQ: 215-230C, run on the hotter side for layer adhesion; TDS 210-230C, 60C plate; table 220C@6/240C@12, 55C plate.
Use Magigoo or glue stick - prints can fuse to smooth plate surfaces when hot. Purge thoroughly on filament changes. Filament is quite flexible; printed parts are weaker along layer lines. Low-voltage circuits, touch sensors, ESD applications.
